seeds.scene: Two side-by-side photos of a busy kitchen counter; in the right panel a small jar of cinnamon present in the left has been removed and the gap is partially filled by repositioned items.
seeds.question: What object was removed from the right panel?
seeds.lever: Detect missing item among many objects with intentional repositioning camouflage.

seeds.scene: Two near-identical portraits of a person with hands visible. In the right panel one hand has 6 fingers instead of 5; everything else identical.
seeds.question: What is the difference?
seeds.answer: the right panel shows an extra finger on one hand
seeds.lever: Spot anatomical mistake against natural reference; count fingers carefully.

seeds.scene: Two photos of an open wardrobe with many garments. One shirt's color is a slightly different shade of red between the two panels; all other items identical.
seeds.question: Which item changed?
seeds.lever: Detect subtle hue shift on one item among many similarly-colored items.

seeds.scene: Two desk photos; in the right panel two items (stapler and tape dispenser) have swapped positions. Counts and inventory match.
seeds.question: What changed between the panels?
seeds.answer: stapler and tape dispenser positions are swapped
seeds.lever: Detect transposition rather than addition/removal; identify the specific pair.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a chalkboard menu. In the right panel, 'soup of the day' is replaced with 'salad of the day'; layout otherwise identical.
seeds.question: What text changed?
seeds.lever: OCR-level diff over many words; locate the single substituted word.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a fruit bowl with 8 fruits. In the right panel one apple is noticeably larger than its left counterpart; all positions identical.
seeds.question: Which fruit's size changed?
seeds.lever: Detect a scale change of a single object while position and identity are preserved.

seeds.scene: Two near-identical playground photos. The shadows in the right panel are angled differently (sun position changed) but only one object's shadow direction has changed; the rest match the left panel.
seeds.question: Which object's shadow disagrees with the rest?
seeds.lever: Cross-pair shadow consistency rather than per-pair difference; spot the local inconsistency.

seeds.scene: Two parking-lot photos with many cars. The right panel has exactly one fewer car than the left; the empty space is partially filled by a dropped shadow that mimics a car.
seeds.question: How many fewer cars are in the right panel?
seeds.lever: Cross-image counting under shadow camouflage.

seeds.scene: Two photos of the same intersection. In one panel a street sign's text is mirror-reversed; everything else matches.
seeds.question: Which panel contains the mirrored element?
seeds.answer: the panel with the reversed sign
seeds.lever: Detect orientation flip on a localized element vs whole-frame consistency.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a crowd of 12 people. One person's shirt pattern changes from stripes to checks between panels; same person, same pose.
seeds.question: Which person changed clothing pattern?
seeds.answer: specify the person whose shirt pattern changed
seeds.lever: Spot subtle pattern change on a single item amid a busy crowd.

seeds.scene: Two near-identical park-bench photos. In the right panel a small portion of the background tree was replaced by sky; foreground identical.
seeds.question: What changed in the background?
seeds.answer: a tree-trunk segment in the right panel was replaced by sky
seeds.lever: Detect localized background edit while foreground is invariant.

seeds.scene: Two near-identical office photos. The wall clock minute hand is at :12 in left, :17 in right; everything else identical.
seeds.question: What changed?
seeds.answer: the minute hand position on the wall clock (advanced 5 minutes)
seeds.lever: Detect small dial change among many static elements.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a store window with reflections of the street. In the right panel the reflection has been altered: a passing bus appears in the reflection but not in the actual street view.
seeds.question: What is the inconsistency?
seeds.answer: right panel's reflection contains a bus that doesn't exist in the live scene
seeds.lever: Cross-check reflection against ground-truth scene content.

seeds.scene: Two outdoor scenes that look identical in foreground; in one panel ground is wet (puddles, dark pavement) and in the other dry. Sky is similar in both.
seeds.question: Which panel was photographed AFTER rain?
seeds.lever: Identify wetness cues (puddles, color depth) without relying on overhead sky.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a living room; exactly two differences between them: one painting rotated 90°, and a candle moved from coffee table to mantel.
seeds.question: List ALL differences.
seeds.lever: Detect multiple low-salience differences and list completely without spurious additions.

seeds.scene: Two team photos with 8 people in a row. In the right panel positions 3 and 6 have swapped places; same individuals, same uniforms.
seeds.question: Which positions swapped between the panels?
seeds.lever: Identify two-person swap in row context with high inter-person similarity.

seeds.scene: Two photos of a storefront with a brand logo. In the right panel one letter in the brand name is replaced by a similar-looking letter ('I' → 'l').
seeds.question: What changed in the logo?
seeds.answer: a letter substitution in the brand name
seeds.lever: Detect single-character substitution in stylized logo text.

seeds.scene: Two tool-tray photos with 10 hand tools. In the right panel, a screwdriver is reversed (handle to tip swapped end-for-end) while all other tools remain.
seeds.question: Which tool changed orientation?
seeds.lever: Spot end-for-end flip vs. positional change.

seeds.scene: Two pie-chart infographics with 6 slices. In the right panel two adjacent slices have swapped colors but kept the same labels and sizes.
seeds.question: Which two slices' colors were swapped?
seeds.answer: the adjacent pair whose colors traded
seeds.lever: Detect color permutation while size/label stays the same.

seeds.scene: Two yoga-pose photos. In the right panel the subject's right hand has moved from palm-down to palm-up, but body posture and all other limbs identical.
seeds.question: What change occurred?
seeds.answer: right hand rotated from palm-down to palm-up
seeds.lever: Detect micro-pose change in a single joint.
